description: DOCX-backed cancellation flow: cancellation appears in meesho_sales with order_status = 'Cancelled' and may appear in meesho_reverse with transaction_type = 'cancelled'; no shipping fee is charged and any settlement row is order_status = 'Cancelled' with zero or small settled amount.
entry_condition: Seller or buyer cancels the order before fulfilment/settlement.
exit_condition: No shipping fee is charged; settlement row may exist as Cancelled with settled_amount = 0 or small value.
name: Meesho cancellation flow

description: DOCX-backed forward lifecycle: Meesho app order is captured in meesho_sales, moves through order_status values Ordered/Shipped/Delivered, enters the 7-day return window, then settles 7 days after delivery through meesho_settlement and meesho_forward_expenses.
display_name: Meesho forward order to settlement flow
entry_condition: meesho_sales row exists for a customer order, usually transaction_type = 'forward' when populated.
exit_condition: meesho_settlement has order_status = 'Delivered' and seller payout is paid on the 7-day post-delivery cycle; forward fees are invoiced in meesho_forward_expenses.
name: Meesho forward order to settlement flow

description: Reconciliation process composed from the DOCX Reconciliation Use Cases section; external bank/logistics/PG/ERP cards are not created here.
name: Meesho marketplace-internal reconciliation

description: DOCX-backed reverse lifecycle: buyer return or courier RTO creates a meesho_reverse row, return logistics are tracked in meesho_returns and reverse shipping costs in meesho_other_charges_expenses, while meesho_reverse_expenses is currently empty/provisioned; settlement is adjusted as negative payout in meesho_settlement.
entry_condition: Return is initiated within window or courier fails delivery; meesho_reverse uses transaction_type = 'reverse' and order_status in Return/rto where populated.
exit_condition: meesho_settlement has order_status in ('Return','RTO') with return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax and negative or zero settlement effect applied to a later payment cycle.
name: Meesho return / RTO settlement-adjustment flow
